decision: Full car = Scan Files/Full Car.stl (25.0M tris), 4 mm for full-car moves, 2 mm front-half crop for close-ups
why: Brief's suggested scan; length 4,663 mm after ground crop vs VB spec ~4,670 mm; 2 mm full car OOM-killed prep, so close-ups use a front crop (A90 approach)

decision: 22 of 28 part/state scans are in the car's Artec frame (median 1-4 mm on the car, regcheck.py + red-over-grey renders); all prepped --like car4.json. Headlight-project scans (hl_*) and 'VB Bumper Inside' are in their own frames and are not used
why: Exploded parts must seat exactly where they came off; scans in another frame would need a global registration that can drift

decision: Shot order: front 3/4 turntable -> rear 3/4 orbit -> wheel close-up -> hood-scoop close-up -> trunk opens -> top-down -> exploded view -> logo
why: Brief + Temerario reference order; the wheels were scanned (unlike A90/Huracan) so the wheel close-up is real detail; the hood scoop is the VB's signature; no hood-open state is registered, the trunk-open family is

decision: No trunk-open shot; the 'panels open' beat is the front end coming off (bumper+grille, lower garnish) over the Front Removed / Bumpers Removed state scans
why: Trunk hinge fit (tools/trunk.py) only reached 10.8 mm median, the No-Trunk diff mask missed part of the deck, and the Trunk-Open tub capture has holes - the open trunk rendered with black gaps (chk/hinge.jpg). The front state scans are dense and registered

decision: Licence plates (front and rear) flattened onto their fitted planes in every mesh (tools/flatten_plates.py); blank plate shapes remain
why: Close-up render showed the embossed plate numbers readable in the scan; a public reel must not show a real car's plate. Flattening keeps the plate shape (true to the scan) without the characters

decision: Exploded view = front bumper (+grille, blank plate), lower garnish, rear bumper, right front/door/rear flares and right side skirt lift into layers above the car over the all-panels-off composite; right-side camera orbit rear 3/4 -> front 3/4
why: Every panel part scan that registers to the car; flares/skirt exist only for the right side so the camera stays on the right. Temerario 25-31 s stacks panels above the car - portrait-friendly; first layout (bumpers along the length) clipped the bumpers at the frame edges

decision: Front-off shot: bumper slides sideways (+X, away from the camera) and drops; garnish follows half a beat later; camera pushes in on the crash beam
why: First preview flew the bumper at the lens (lessons: keep parts from flying at the lens)

decision: Music = subaru-wrx-vb_track.mp3 (original rally drum-and-bass generated for this reel by the coordinating session). Grid from kick peaks: downbeats 11.2522 + 1.39591 n (171.9 BPM, 7 ms rms); ambient intro hits at 5.224 and 8.707; drop 11.252; fade 33-34, silent ~36
why: Brief: cut on the track's own accents; ive beats reports the 86 BPM half-time; lessons: anchor on kick peaks, not the first flux onset

decision: Cuts 5.224 / 8.707 (intro hits), 11.252 (drop, wheel -> scoop), 14.044, 18.232, 21.024, 32.191 (bar downbeats); explode separates on 22.419 and locks home on 30.795; logo 32.191 -> 35.5 through the fade
why: Slow turntables sit on the quiet intro (Temerario pacing), the close-up hands over to the hood scoop exactly on the drop, 2-3 bar holds after the drop, and the money shot gets 8 bars with separation and lock on downbeats; the reel ends where the music does

decision: Reviewed final s1,s2,s3,s4,s6 contact sheet (chk/final_q1.jpg): kept all as rendered
why: Framing and look match the previews (silver on black, car fills the 9:16 width). Scan holes at the wiper cowl and scoop mouth, and the far wheel under the car in s3, are real gaps in the scan data. They are not render faults, so a re-render would not fix them.

decision: s5_front and s7_explode re-queued with a project-local shot.py copy that turns Cycles persistent data off for shots with keyed parts
why: lessons.md (added by siblings during this run): persistent data dropped lights or rendered black frames in animated-part shots. Both shots have moving parts. Turning persistent data off is slower but removes the cause. A max-luma scan of every frame is still run before assembly.

decision: Accepted final s5_front (64 frames, persistent data off)
why: Every frame is lit (min of per-frame max luma 255). The bumper with its blank plate slides clear to the car's left and shows the scanned crash structure. Checked in chk/final_s5.jpg and chk/s5big.jpg.

decision: Per-clip src_fps = 30*N/(slot+4) for s2-s7; assembled v1 (35.47 s, 1064 frames)
why: The first assembly showed 1-2 cloned frames before every cut (minterpolate 2N-3, as lessons.md warns). After the fix only the assembler's single cut frame remains. Cuts were measured within 15 ms of their kicks.

decision: v2 started on the user's relayed request (via subaru-wrx-va): luma check, cut timing against the decoded audio, and a scene order from scan features set by a director agent
why: These are now user rules in lessons.md and workflow.md (Scene direction). The v1 per-frame mean-luma scan is clean, max frame-to-frame step 4%. tools/cutcheck.py shows the v1 cuts land 51-76 ms after the broadband kick onsets because the 40-120 Hz grid read late. The grid was refit on broadband onsets: 11.1910 + 1.39609 n.

decision: v2 plan adopted from the director agent (direction.md, director.md): opener, s4 scoop reused, front-off hero on the drop, side-off, rear-off, reassemble, fade, small logo. v1 s1, s2, s3, s5, s6 and s7 dropped.
why: User rules relayed by the parent session: order from this car's scan features, front -> side -> rear travel, one section per sequence, parts come off section by section toward the camera with their inner faces shown (the bumper scans include insides), bumper-removed data is the hero beat with labels, whole car in the opener, no redundant rotations, fade then small logo. ive director flagged s1~s2 as a repeat (IoU 0.83), and s5/s7 as too wide (13-23 % coverage) with dead frames.

decision: Front bumper and plate flip about a shared pivot at the bumper's bbox centre (0, -2.007, 0.466); rear bumper about (0.006, 1.952, 0.548)
why: They are separate blends. With per-blend bbox pivots the plate would swing off the bumper during the -160 deg flip.
